notes: Mirror of customers_core.json for the vendor side, following the same conventions: staging keys carry legacy IDs verbatim, every unknown SAP customizing value is a lookup_passthrough XREF, and open mapping decisions are left OUT rather than guessed. Address fields are simplified vs. the customers treatment: LFA1 keeps a one-line street string (STRAS) plus a split-derived city (ORT01), because unlike customers (billing vs shipping), vendors have exactly one free-text Address with no second address to disambiguate -- still a heuristic parse, flagged the same way the customers_addresses spec flags its own parsing. BP NUMBERING CONVENTION (decision made; was an open item): Business Partner staging keys are derived, not raw legacy IDs -- customers take the EVEN series (Customer_ID x 2, see customers_core.json), vendors the ODD (Vendor_ID x 2 + 1) -- because raw IDs collide in BUT000 (customer 1 vs vendor 1). Every PARTNER/LIFNR staging key, including EKKO references from the PO and contract specs, uses the same odd derivation so document references resolve; a real load allocates BP numbers from a configured number range instead.
